advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: I don't have jewelry... I fly private but I don't own a jet. I really don't overspend. I always have enough money if things go wrong in the company that I can fund it.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid overspending on status symbols and keep enough reserves to fund your company if things go wrong.
advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不过度消费，保留充足备用资金

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Focus on Making Money Over Tax Hacks
advice_items.quote: You got to make money to pay so my view pay all the taxes I can because I get to keep the balance.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on generating income rather than obsessing over tax hacks—paying taxes means you are making money.
advice_items.summary_zh: 专注创造利润，而非沉迷避税技巧

advice_items.quote: I realized that literacy and understanding the business is the first priority.
advice_items.summary_en: Make business literacy and thoroughly understanding how a business works your top priority.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把商业与财务认知放在首位

advice_items.quote: It's really great to have a mentor, someone that really knows what they're doing and that has worked.
advice_items.summary_en: Find a mentor who genuinely knows what they are doing and has a proven track record.
advice_items.summary_zh: 寻找真正懂行且有成果的导师

advice_items.quote: I was goofing around and I got down to 600,000. I said, 'That's it. I got to get myself back on purpose and focus.'
advice_items.summary_en: Cut out distractions and get yourself back on purpose with laser focus when performance slips.
advice_items.summary_zh: 戒掉散漫玩乐，重新聚焦核心目标

advice_items.quote: Of the 600,000 I had left, I gave 200 to a church. And I said, 'They're going to use it better than I was.'
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and generosity, giving back even when you are recovering from a setback.
advice_items.summary_zh: 心怀信仰与感恩，低谷时仍懂得回馈

advice_items.quote: It's just ideas. It's an attitude. That's it. It's an attitude. You can change your attitude about anything that's under your control.
advice_items.summary_en: Growing up poor does not cap your potential—success comes down to ideas and changing the attitude within your control.
advice_items.summary_zh: 出身不决定上限，改变心态就能改命

advice_items.quote: Put your attention on making the money, not worrying about losing it.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus your energy on making money and planning for what could go right instead of fearing loss.
advice_items.summary_zh: 聚焦把钱赚到，别把精力耗在怕亏钱

advice_items.quote: What's the ROI for worry? ... You've got to take the viewpoint with enthusiasm. I can and will make it happen... and get busy doing it.
advice_items.summary_en: Stop wasting energy on worry—adopt an enthusiastic 'I can and will make it happen' mindset and get busy executing.
advice_items.summary_zh: 停止内耗焦虑，用热情立刻投入行动

advice_items.quote: Never tell a lie. Always be honest. Whatever it is, the brutal truth.
advice_items.summary_en: Never tell a lie and commit to total honesty, even when it means delivering the brutal truth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不说谎，始终坚持残酷的坦诚

advice_items.quote: Care about my customers first and my shareholders second, and I come in third.
advice_items.summary_en: Put your customers first, your shareholders second, and yourself third in any business you build.
advice_items.summary_zh: 客户第一，股东第二，自己排在最后

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: When I start a business and I own it... I never sell until we sell the whole company. I'm not into trading my stocks in and out. I played the long game and that's what works.
advice_items.summary_en: Build and hold ownership in your businesses for the long game instead of trading in and out of stocks.
advice_items.summary_zh: 持有公司长期股权，不搞短线投机

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: The purpose of business is to help others... get to self-sustaining. And let's prove that by giving people enough value that they give us more for what we give them.
advice_items.summary_en: Make your business self-sustaining by helping others and delivering more value than customers pay you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 商业本质是帮人解决问题并超额交付价值

advice_items.quote: You create success. It's not like it's a jewel and that you've got it and you don't have to do anything else. You got to continue to outcreate.
advice_items.summary_en: Never grow complacent after achieving success—it is not a static trophy, so you must continuously outcreate.
advice_items.summary_zh: 成功不是终点，必须持续创造新价值

advice_items.quote: Miami is... the accumulation of people that are going somewhere with their money and their resource... they're creators. That's what you want to be.
advice_items.summary_en: Place yourself in environments filled with ambitious creators who actively deploy their resources to build.
advice_items.summary_zh: 靠近有进取心的创造者与顶级圈层

advice_items.quote: I go for it every day... Clint... said, 'Bob, never let the old man in.'
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain disciplined daily health habits like cold plunges, cycling, and swimming, and refuse to adopt an aging mindset.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持每日冷水浴与运动，保持年轻态

advice_items.quote: They're enthusiastic and they know how to communicate. They are really people that want to contribute to life.
advice_items.summary_en: Develop strong communication skills, contagious enthusiasm, and a vision to contribute to the future.
advice_items.summary_zh: 培养感染力、沟通力与贡献精神

advice_items.quote: Geniuses have a strong desire to work hard and long. They're willing to give all they got to a project.
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate a strong desire to work hard and long, giving everything you have to your projects and fellow human beings.
advice_items.summary_zh: 甘愿长时间拼搏，对事业全力以赴

advice_items.quote: Focus on your future success and keep going. Don't introvert on your losses... A loser loses three times, he's out. A winner loses 20, he's still in.
advice_items.summary_en: Learn from your losses without dwelling on them—winners actually lose more times than losers because they never quit.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别沉溺于失败，赢家输二十次依然在场

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年时薪仅50美分，大学时靠5000美元本金在导师指导下投资起步，滚雪球至360万美元（一度回撤至60万美元后重新聚焦）；后来因儿子患胶质母细胞瘤转入生物医药领域抗癌，并将生物科技公司以210亿美元出售。
recommended_books_or_mentors: Clint Eastwood ('Never let the old man in')
guests.role_or_title: Biotech Entrepreneur & Investor (Former Cancer Biotech Company Owner)
guests.wealth_detail: $10B-$14B net worth; sold biotech company for $21B; made $1B in a single day
guests.zero_start_advice: 把注意力放在赚钱和未来成功上，而不是担心亏钱；找一位真正懂行的导师，先把商业与财务认知放在首位；保持热情与行动力，拒绝内耗焦虑，在失败后坚持到底并持续创造价值。
